lines.name: Comanche Tap - New Comanche 345 kV and new ring-bus station on Lawton Eastside - Terry Road (ERAS-2025-001)
lines.description: New substations: New Comanche 345 kV station (ERAS-2025-026), New 3-breaker ring bus on Lawton Eastside - Terry Road 345 kV. AEP facilities study (Apr-May 2026) for SPP ERAS-2025-001/024 (744 MW gas) scopes a new ~4-mile 345 kV line, a new 345 kV ring-bus station and two 345/138 kV autos at Comanche
